ruling.recommended_action: No fare adjustment: explain to rider that the detour via Halus Link was requested and agreed in-app before the turn-off; fare quoted was fixed and unaffected. Close dispute.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment from ~10:04:20 to ~10:07:00 (east along Tampines Ave/Halus Link area instead of the direct TPE alignment of the quoted polyline). Exempt under RD-5: the driver proposed the specific diversion via Halus Link in-app at 10:01:00 and the rider expressly agreed at 10:01:40, both timestamps preceding the segment start, so the route change was mutually agreed before leaving the optimal route (also consistent with the driver's statement). RD-4(b) speed bands on the optimal route are band 4, so no independent traffic-corroborated exemption.

rejected_claims.reason: RydeX is a fixed-quote (non-metered) service; mileage change does not alter the fare. The only off-route segment was agreed by the rider in-app before it occurred (RD-5), so no unexempted detour exists and no additional published charges were applied (tolls/waiting/edit-destination all 0). Nothing to refund under RD-1/RD-2.
